packageRules.description: Non-major: automerge after CI is green
Major: PR for manual review, never automerge

coturn is the public TURN relay and CI never runs the container: a bump needs the empirical gate by hand (build the image, render conf with opec, run turnserver, check no 'Bad configuration' lines, the 5349 TLS listener, turnutils_uclient Allocate+data with REST creds, 403 for 127.0.0.1 and ::ffff:127.0.0.1, relay ports in range). Reviewed by hand, never automerged; this rule is LAST in packageRules, so it overrides the generic automerge rules above (Renovate: later rules win).
